sources.title: The Method of Structured, Focused Comparison
sources.methods: Standardized questions asked across theoretically selected cases.
sources.use_in_release: Cross-case comparison design.
sources.limitations: Method guide, not case evidence.

sources.title: Understanding Process Tracing
sources.methods: Temporal examination of diagnostic causal-process observations and competing explanations.
sources.use_in_release: Chronology-preserving within-case analysis.
sources.limitations: Does not make archival evidence experimental.

sources.title: Conducting secondary analysis of qualitative data: Should we, can we, and how?
sources.methods: Critical interpretive synthesis of qualitative secondary analysis practice.
sources.use_in_release: Defines epistemic and contextual limits of reusing archived qualitative data.
sources.limitations: General method review.

sources.title: What Makes a Good Response? An Empirical Analysis of Quality in Qualitative Interviews
sources.authors: Jonathan Ivey; Anjalie Field; Ziang Xiao
sources.methods: 343 interviews, 16,940 participant responses, 14 deposited research projects; 2,400 human annotations on a validation subset.
sources.use_in_release: Source discovery and interview-corpus quality guidance.
sources.limitations: Preprint; corpus harmonization may lose original project context.

sources.title: Waterfront Toronto Public Consultation on the draft MIDP: Round One Feedback Report
sources.methods: Four public meetings, online consultation, written submissions, library drop-ins; appendices preserve extensive feedback.
sources.use_in_release: Standing, public objections, data/governance and scope challenges.
sources.limitations: Summarized by project authority; not all private negotiations visible.

sources.title: Threshold Issues Resolution Documents
sources.methods: Documented resolution of threshold scope, governance, privacy, land and commercial issues.
sources.use_in_release: Material schema revision and authority reallocation.
sources.limitations: Records agreed terms, not complete bargaining transcript.

sources.title: DSAP Supplemental Report on the Sidewalk Labs Digital Innovation Appendix
sources.methods: Expert panel review and written commentary; explicitly partial and non-consensus.
sources.use_in_release: Independent challenge, unresolved data governance and public-sector authority.
sources.limitations: No claim that silence means acceptance; panel time constrained.

sources.title: Plan Development Agreement amendments and termination notice
sources.methods: Executed agreement text, amendments, termination clauses and notice.
sources.use_in_release: Formal authority, approval, exit and survival semantics.
sources.limitations: Does not establish causal motive beyond stated/recorded basis.

sources.title: Waterfront Toronto Integrated Annual Report 2019–2020
sources.methods: Annual institutional report summarizing consultation, withdrawal and retained learning.
sources.use_in_release: Outcome attribution and termination boundary.
sources.limitations: Institutional self-report; economic/COVID attribution must not be converted into governance causality.

sources.title: Operational Governance – Open Banking Rules and Guidelines
sources.methods: Formal roles, registration, standards, service levels, complaints, disputes, breach, suspension and exclusion rules.
sources.use_in_release: Institutional compilation and runtime governance.
sources.limitations: Design document; does not prove enacted governance quality.

sources.title: Update on Open Banking
sources.methods: Summary of an independent investigation covering corporate governance, conflicts, procurement/value, accounts and HR.
sources.use_in_release: Governance failure as reopen trigger.
sources.limitations: Summary rather than full underlying evidence.

sources.title: Open Banking Lessons Learned Review
sources.authors: Kirstin Baker / Competition and Markets Authority
sources.methods: Meetings with current/former CMA staff and board, inquiry group, CMA9, OBIE trustees/board and other stakeholders, plus document review.
sources.use_in_release: Technical success/governance failure separation; review gates and lifecycle oversight.
sources.limitations: Institutional learning review, not causal experiment.

sources.title: Recommendations for the next phase of open banking in the UK
sources.methods: Regulatory recommendations and transition design for long-term framework.
sources.use_in_release: Reallocation of long-term authority and institutionalization.
sources.limitations: Prospective design, not completed outcome at publication.

sources.title: Retail banking market investigation case page
sources.methods: Chronological repository of roadmap decisions and oversight letters.
sources.use_in_release: Roadmap completion and continuing oversight chronology.
sources.limitations: Index/timeline, not analytic evidence.

sources.title: Crossrail System Integration Management Plan
sources.methods: Formal plan covering integration authority, review points, requirements, verification, interfaces, configuration and assurance.
sources.use_in_release: Designed schema versus enacted integration.
sources.limitations: Plan existence does not prove implementation or effectiveness.

sources.title: Completing Crossrail
sources.methods: Document analysis and interviews with sponsors, delivery organization and stakeholders.
sources.use_in_release: Interface risk, aspirational planning, cost/effect gaps.
sources.limitations: Retrospective audit after major delay.

sources.title: Independent review of Crossrail – Governance
sources.publisher: Transport for London / Department for Transport
sources.methods: Independent governance review using documentary and stakeholder evidence; public version redacted.
sources.use_in_release: Decision rights, transparency, assurance and governance reset.
sources.limitations: Redactions and commissioning context.

sources.title: Sponsoring a Major Project: The Crossrail Experience
sources.authors: Department for Transport; Infrastructure and Projects Authority
sources.methods: 90+ Chatham House interviews, short surveys, three workshops, internal/external scrutiny and peer review.
sources.use_in_release: Lifecycle governance, integration accountability, assurance, incentives and control gates.
sources.limitations: Confidential interviews unavailable for independent transcript recoding.

sources.title: The Sustainable Groundwater Management Act Governance Conference: Research and Practice — Synthesis Report
sources.methods: Conference synthesis across researchers/practitioners; reports interviews, observation, institutional coding and case studies.
sources.use_in_release: Institutional variety, standing/representation, multi-level governance and data sharing.
sources.limitations: Synthesis contains heterogeneous substudies and some early-stage findings.

sources.title: The relationship between how agencies work together and coordinated outcomes: a configurational analysis
sources.publisher: Journal of Public Administration Research and Theory
sources.methods: Ethnographic data from 2018–2022 and multi-value QCA across 18 groundwater basins.
sources.use_in_release: Collaborative institutional arrangements and coordinated outcomes.
sources.limitations: Published analysis; full article may require purchase; causal scope is configurational, not experimental.

sources.title: Not Whether to Coordinate, But How: Concerns and Mechanism Choice Under a Mandate for Inter-Agency Coordination
sources.authors: Anita Milman; Michael Roberts; Amber Walsh; William Blomquist
sources.publisher: Perspectives on Public Management and Governance
sources.methods: Empirical study of SGMA coordination mechanism choice under top-down mandate.
sources.use_in_release: Autonomy concerns and contingency of mechanism choice.
sources.limitations: Published analysis does not expose all underlying coding decisions.

sources.title: Ascertaining Intergovernmental Coordination Mechanisms
sources.methods: Dataset description reports 52 de-identified interview transcripts; 43 interviews included in the harmonized Qualitative Interview Corpus.
sources.use_in_release: Highest-value next transcript-level calibration source.
sources.limitations: Direct download was not available in this runtime; no transcript-level claims are made in v0.6.

sources.title: The Qualitative Interview Corpus
sources.authors: Jonathan Ivey; Anjalie Field; Ziang Xiao
sources.methods: 343 interviews from 14 open de-identified projects, including 43 intergovernmental coordination interviews.
sources.use_in_release: Future transcript-level coding and interviewer-instrument research.
sources.limitations: Harmonization and extraction may remove some original context; direct download unavailable in this runtime.

sources.title: LinkedIn Preliminary Proxy Statement (Background of the Merger)
sources.methods: Board-approved disclosure of transaction background, alternatives, bids, authority process, terms and risks.
sources.use_in_release: Mature institutional frame and CollapseSafe negative comparator.
sources.limitations: Legally curated disclosure; private motives and conversations are selectively summarized.

sources.title: Microsoft Form 8-K — Completion of LinkedIn acquisition
sources.methods: Formal notice of closing and conversion of shares under the merger agreement.
sources.use_in_release: Target-world Effect evidence.
sources.limitations: Does not evaluate long-run integration value or stakeholder acceptance.

sources.title: Microsoft to acquire LinkedIn
sources.methods: Joint announcement of definitive agreement, price, management and independence commitments.
sources.use_in_release: Public commitment terms.
sources.limitations: Promotional party statement; weaker than SEC filing for contested facts.

sources.title: Transferring, Translating, and Transforming: An Integrative Framework for Managing Knowledge Across Boundaries
sources.methods: Framework of syntactic, semantic and pragmatic boundaries illustrated through collaborative engineering.
sources.use_in_release: Positions relation formation beyond information transfer.
sources.limitations: Not a theory of agent authority or protocol materialization.

sources.title: Life in the Trading Zone: Structuring Coordination Across Boundaries in Postbureaucratic Organizations
sources.authors: Katherine C. Kellogg; Wanda J. Orlikowski; JoAnne Yates
sources.methods: Empirical study of cross-boundary coordination practices under speed and uncertainty.
sources.use_in_release: Visibility, legibility, revision/alignment and coordination pathologies.
sources.limitations: Intra-organizational/postbureaucratic setting, not full sovereign authority.

sources.title: Maneuvering in poor visibility: How firms play the ecosystem game when uncertainty is high
sources.authors: Brice Dattée; Oliver Alexy; Erkko Autio
sources.methods: Inductive study of two organizations creating four nascent ecosystems around generative technologies.
sources.use_in_release: Value propositions not known ex ante; coupled feedback and dynamic control.
sources.limitations: Focal-firm ecosystem orchestration, not neutral multi-principal formation.
